call_points.text: Management set an internal target to achieve ₹100 Cr quarterly revenue in FY27.
FY26 order intake rose 24% YoY, led by higher AI deals and models deployed in production.
Liquidity improved by ₹70 Cr across FY26, strengthening capacity to self-fund investments.
Gross margins exceed 90% for software licenses, 40-45% for implementation, and over 50% for managed services.
Middle East accounts face contracting delays, mitigated by shifting project delivery to India offshore centres.
Company retains ₹50 Cr cash buffer beyond six months working capital runway and is evaluating tuck-in acquisitions.
AI customer base has grown ~4x and models in production are up 5x since 2023.
Normalized EBITDA grew 16.4% QoQ, supported by ongoing operational efficiencies.
Cash and equivalents rose to ₹175.26 Cr, reflecting continued liquidity stability.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹72.96 Cr, net profit ₹9.93 Cr (against a loss of ₹17.6 Cr a year earlier).
Subex reported Q4FY26 normalized EBITDA margin of 14.5% and highlighted in its AI customer base since 2023.
Held Q4FY26 earnings call; guided internal target of ₹100 Cr quarterly run-rate in FY27 supported by 24% order intake growth.
Subex announced a USD 1.93M, 5-year contract to modernize RAFM operations for a leading telecom operator in North Africa using its HyperSense platform.
Subex Limited will announce its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 on November 3, 2026.
